candidate.name: Kartik Sanghi
candidate.headline: iOS Developer with backend, data and edge-AI experience

projects.name: Parkezy
projects.summary: Real-time smart parking iOS app with a backend data layer.
projects.description: Built an iOS parking app in SwiftUI with a FastAPI backend. Designed the persistence layer on Supabase/PostgreSQL, implemented REST APIs for slot availability, and used real-time synchronization so parking availability updated live across devices. Handled structured data flow between the mobile client and the backend.
responsibilities: Designed the PostgreSQL schema and data access layer
Implemented REST APIs for real-time slot availability
Built real-time synchronization between client and backend
achievements: Reduced average slot-search time in user testing

projects.name: Setu AI
projects.summary: Edge-AI anomaly detection on a microcontroller.
projects.description: Developed a 1D-CNN model for real-time signal classification deployed to a MAX78000 edge-AI microcontroller using Edge Impulse. Built a Python data-processing pipeline to clean, window and label raw sensor time-series, engineered features, and evaluated model accuracy before deployment.
responsibilities: Built a Python pipeline for sensor time-series cleaning and feature engineering
Deployed the model to an edge microcontroller
achievements: Achieved real-time on-device inference within power budget

Implemented custom animations and layout components
